title: 兩隻匙羹
mood: newly in love, sun-drunk and in no hurry
subject: sharing one bowl of tofu pudding with two spoons at the Lamma pier with someone you have just started seeing
caption: Cantonese Afrobeats pop with a light dancehall lean. A syncopated kick and rim-click groove, a steady shaker and conga loop, a rimshot clave, a short talking-drum fill at each turnaround; palm-muted highlife-style clean electric guitar licks weaving between the vocal lines; a warm round sub bass and a soft Rhodes. Warm and close with a laid-back off-beat groove, percussion spread wide, guitar and voice forward. Relaxed, breathy female lead in the mid register, short repeated chant hooks, soft backing harmonies on the chorus. 104 BPM, A major. Newly in love, sun-drunk and in no hurry. No four-on-the-floor kick, no amapiano log drum, no funk slap bass, no EDM drop, no autotune, no trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Verse]
榕樹灣碼頭 船啱啱開走
你話唔緊要 等下一班就得
買咗一碗豆腐花 兩隻匙羹
黃糖你全部撥晒過嚟我嗰邊

[Pre-Chorus]
你膊頭曬到紅晒 自己仲未知
我唔講住 想睇多陣

[Chorus]
慢慢食 慢慢食
下一班船 唔使趕
一碗豆腐花 兩隻匙羹
你食一啖 我食一啖 我好似鍾意咗你

[Verse]
你講你細個喺呢度學游水
飲咗成肚海水 返學畀人笑
你講得好大聲 隔籬枱個伯伯都笑埋
我一路聽 一路咬住隻匙羹

[Chorus]
慢慢食 慢慢食
下一班船 都唔使趕
一碗豆腐花 兩隻匙羹
最後一啖你留畀我 我知我鍾意咗你

[Outro]
船泊埋嚟喇
我哋再坐多陣
